# Notices and licensing

`pdf-media-extraction` is an independent, read-only PDF media inspection
project. It is not produced, sponsored, or endorsed by the Apache Software
Foundation or the Apache PDFBox project.

## Runtime dependency

The project depends on Apache PDFBox 3.0.8 and its transitive Apache FontBox,
PDFBox IO, and Apache Commons Logging components through Maven. Those
components are not vendored or relocated here. Apache PDFBox and FontBox are
